ideas.pitch: An IoT-enabled smart irrigation and soil health monitoring dashboard optimized for local Indian agricultural conditions.

ideas.title: ViksitAgri IoT Crop Health & Sustainable Irrigation System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the 'Viksit Bharat @2047' sustainability mandate by targeting resource conservation in agriculture, paired with a working IoT prototype.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision mobile web app that allows citizens to photograph road potholes or broken public amenities and automatically logs them into a municipal GIS dashboard.
ideas.problem_statement: Smart Solutions, Smarter Society – Software applications, web services, mobile applications, chatbots, healthcare and bioinformatics solutions.
ideas.title: CivicShield AI Public Infrastructure Safety Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a live, working mobile capture demo with clear civic utility, echoing real-world impact hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: An agentic AI tool that predicts microgrid energy loads and automates renewable source switching for campus-scale sustainability.

ideas.title: ViksitGrid Energy Demand Forecasting Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the hot trend of agentic AI combined with quantifiable carbon-reduction metrics that appeal to academic and institutional judges.

ideas.pitch: A low-cost hardware and vision pipeline prototype that classifies dry and wet waste streams in real time for smart campus waste management.
ideas.problem_statement: From Concept to Reality – Hardware prototype

ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings a physical hardware demonstration to the table, perfectly fitting the concept-to-reality track and sustainability theme.

ideas.pitch: An LLM-driven assistant designed for rural clinics to verify local drug interaction risks and scan handwritten local prescriptions safely.
ideas.problem_statement: Smart Solutions, Smarter Society – Software applications, web services, mobile applications, chatbots, healthcare and bioinformatics solutions.
ideas.title: MedVerify AI Prescription and Drug Interaction Checker
